correctness.rationale: Reconstructed source coordinates z=rs²,x=1 and gradient components s^(2m−2)(s²D,2sM,h′) where D=h+rh′ and M=mh−rh′; since V=2sM/h′, field extension degree equals reduced rational function φ=M²/(h′D). Coprimality uses squarefree h, h(0)≠0 and D+M=(m+1)h. Exceptional cancellations yield φ=r²h′/D when p|m, and φ=D/h′ when p|m+1, with degrees m and m−1; φ′=rh(2h′+rh′′)/D² establishes separability criterion. F_y=0 in char2 makes image line; distinct smooth conics remain so. Independently verified modular symbolic example rational-map degrees/separability for (p,m)=(3,2),(3,3),(5,5),(7,7) and char0 m3; these finite checks are not used as a proof of all parameters.

value.rationale: A complete characteristic-sensitive polar degree calculation for the same smooth conic configuration, including inseparability boundary and opposite realizability, is an independently useful structural classification. It distinguishes field degree from geometric fiber counts rather than merely rebranding known characteristic-zero birationality.

final_claim: For pairwise distinct nonzero ai in an algebraically closed field and F=x∏(xz+ai y²), m>=2, the polar map has total field degree 2m−1 ordinarily, m for odd p|m, m−1 for odd p|m+1; in char2 its image is a line. For odd p|m it is inseparable iff 2h′+rh′′ vanishes, equivalently h=A(r^p)+r^{p−1}B(r^p), with both separable and purely inseparable degree-p examples at m=p.
limitations: Admissible coefficients pairwise distinct nonzero, k algebraically closed, m>=2; no full inseparable-degree decomposition for all polynomials h.
